title: QR Code Generator
description: Generate a QR code for text or a URL.
tagline: Turn text or links into QR codes

steps: Enter text or paste a complete URL in the input field.
Select Generate QR Code to create the code preview.
Use Download to save the QR image as a PNG file.
features: You can create QR codes for links, contact details or short text without creating an account.
Converts text and URLs into QR codes.
Generates the code in your browser after the page loads.

faqs.question: Download the generated QR code as a PNG image.
faqs.answer: Does this QR generator upload my text?

faqs.question: The QR code is generated in your browser; the text is not sent to a ToolNest server.
faqs.answer: Can I make a QR code for a website?

faqs.question: Yes. Paste the full website address, including https://, then generate the code.
faqs.answer: How do I save my QR code?

title: Slug Generator
description: Create clean, URL-friendly slugs from text.

steps: Enter a title or phrase in the text box.
Review the generated lowercase slug in the result area.
Copy the result and use it in a page or post URL.
features: Creates readable, lowercase URL slugs.
Replaces spaces and punctuation with hyphens.
Processes text locally in your browser.

faqs.question: What is a URL slug?
faqs.answer: A slug is the readable part of a URL that identifies a page, usually written in lowercase with hyphens between words.

faqs.question: Can I use the generated slug in a website URL?
faqs.answer: Yes. Review it first to ensure it is unique and accurately describes the page.

faqs.question: Does the slug generator support every language?
faqs.answer: This version produces ASCII slugs, so non-Latin characters may be omitted.

title: Text Case Converter
description: Convert text case and count words, characters and lines.
tagline: Make every word fit your style

steps: Paste or type your text into the input box.
Choose the case style you want, such as UPPERCASE or lowercase.
Review the converted text and copy the result.
features: Supports several common text case styles.
Keeps the original input available while you try different styles.
Includes word, character and line information where available.

faqs.question: Does this tool change the meaning of my text?
faqs.answer: No. It changes letter casing only; review names and abbreviations after conversion.

faqs.question: Can I convert a long text?
faqs.answer: You can paste text into the browser-based editor. Very large inputs may depend on your device performance.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. The conversion runs in your browser.

title: JSON Formatter & Validator
description: Validate JSON and format or minify it.

steps: Paste your JSON data into the input area.
Choose Format JSON to indent it, or Minify JSON to remove unnecessary whitespace.
If the input is valid, review and copy or download the result.
features: Checks JSON syntax before formatting.
Creates readable indented JSON or compact minified JSON.
Processes the supplied text in your browser.

faqs.question: What does a JSON formatter do?
faqs.answer: It checks JSON syntax and changes whitespace and indentation to make the data easier to read or compact.

faqs.question: Why does my JSON show an error?
faqs.answer: JSON requires double-quoted property names and strings, valid commas, and matching braces and brackets. Check the reported syntax issue.

faqs.question: Does formatting change the data values?
faqs.answer: Formatting changes whitespace and indentation, not the parsed JSON values.

title: Base64 Encoder / Decoder
description: Encode or decode text with UTF-8 support.

steps: Enter the text you want to encode or decode.
Choose Encode Base64 or Decode Base64.
Review the output, then copy or download it.
features: Supports UTF-8 text encoding and decoding.
Offers separate encode and decode actions.
Runs in your browser without a ToolNest account.

faqs.question: Is Base64 encryption?
faqs.answer: No. Base64 is an encoding format, not encryption. It does not protect confidential information.

faqs.question: Why does decoded text look incorrect?
faqs.answer: The input may not be valid Base64 or may represent bytes that are not valid UTF-8 text.

faqs.question: Can I encode non-English text?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool uses UTF-8 handling for text.

title: Unit Converter
description: Convert length, weight and temperature units.

steps: Choose Length, Weight or Temperature.
Enter the value and select the source and target units.
Read the converted value in the result area.
features: Converts common length, weight and temperature units.
Updates the result as you change values or units.
Runs locally in your browser.

faqs.question: Which unit categories are supported?
faqs.answer: This version supports length, weight and temperature conversions.

faqs.question: Why is a temperature conversion rejected?
faqs.answer: Values below absolute zero are not physically valid and are rejected by the converter.

faqs.question: Are conversion results exact?
faqs.answer: Results use standard conversion factors and may be rounded for display.

title: Age & Date Difference
description: Calculate age or the days between two dates.

steps: Choose the starting date.
Choose an ending date, or keep the default current date.
Select Calculate and review the date difference.
features: Shows years, months and days between dates.
Also reports the total number of days.
Checks for invalid or reversed date ranges.

faqs.question: Can I calculate my age?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enter your date of birth as the start date and use today as the end date.

faqs.question: Can the end date be before the start date?
faqs.answer: No. The end date must be the same as or later than the start date.

faqs.question: Does this tool store my dates?
faqs.answer: No. The calculation runs in your browser.

title: Color Converter
description: Convert HEX colors into RGB and HSL values.

steps: Choose a color with the picker or enter a HEX value.
Select Convert if needed to calculate the color formats.
Copy the HEX, RGB or HSL values from the result.
features: Accepts common 3-digit and 6-digit HEX values.
Converts HEX to RGB and HSL.
Displays a color swatch for visual reference.

faqs.question: What HEX formats are accepted?
faqs.answer: The converter accepts 3-digit and 6-digit hexadecimal color values, with or without the # symbol.

faqs.question: What do RGB and HSL mean?
faqs.answer: RGB describes red, green and blue channel values. HSL describes hue, saturation and lightness.

faqs.question: Why is my color value invalid?
faqs.answer: Check that the value contains only hexadecimal characters and has either three or six digits.

title: Text Diff Checker
description: Compare two text blocks and identify changed lines.

steps: Paste the original text into the first box.
Paste the revised text into the second box.
Choose Compare and review the marked line differences.
features: Compares two text blocks line by line.
Highlights added and removed lines with simple markers.
Useful for reviewing drafts, notes and code snippets.

faqs.question: Does the diff checker compare files?
faqs.answer: This version compares text pasted into the two input areas; it does not upload or compare files directly.

faqs.question: Does it ignore spaces or capitalization?
faqs.answer: The current comparison checks each line as text, so spacing and letter-case differences can count as changes.

faqs.question: Is my text sent to a server?
faqs.answer: No. The comparison runs in your browser.

title: Markdown Previewer
description: Preview basic Markdown safely as formatted text.

steps: Type or paste Markdown into the editor.
Review the formatted preview beside or below your input.
Copy the visible preview text or clear the editor to start again.
features: Previews common Markdown headings and emphasis.
Supports basic links and inline code.
Escapes input text before rendering the preview.

faqs.question: Does this previewer support all Markdown features?
faqs.answer: It supports a basic subset of Markdown. Advanced extensions and every Markdown specification feature are not included.

faqs.question: Can I preview links?
faqs.answer: Yes. Basic HTTP and HTTPS Markdown links are supported in the preview.

faqs.question: Is the preview saved automatically?
faqs.answer: No. The preview is created in the current browser session.

title: URL Encode / Decode
description: Encode or decode URL components.

steps: Paste the text or encoded component.
Choose Encode component or Decode component.
Review the result and copy it for use in your URL or application.
features: Encodes and decodes URL components.
Helps handle spaces and reserved characters in URL data.
Processes text in your browser.

faqs.question: Is URL encoding the same as Base64?
faqs.answer: No. URL encoding replaces characters with percent-encoded representations so they can be safely included in a URL component.

faqs.question: Should I encode a full URL?
faqs.answer: This tool encodes a component. Encoding an entire URL can also encode separators such as / and ?, so use it for the appropriate part of a URL.

faqs.question: Why does decoding fail?
faqs.answer: The input may contain an incomplete or invalid percent-encoding sequence.

title: Meta Tag Generator
description: Generate copy-ready SEO meta tag markup.

steps: Enter your page title and meta description.
Optionally provide a valid HTTP or HTTPS canonical URL.
Choose Generate and copy the HTML markup into your page head.
features: Generates a title tag and meta description.
Supports an optional canonical URL.
Validates the canonical URL protocol before generating markup.

faqs.question: Where do I put the generated meta tags?
faqs.answer: Add the generated tags inside the head element of the relevant HTML page.

faqs.question: What is a meta description?
faqs.answer: It is a short page summary that search engines may use when presenting a search result snippet.

faqs.question: Does a meta description guarantee a higher ranking?
faqs.answer: No. It can help describe a page in search results, but it does not guarantee rankings or a particular snippet.

title: CSV ↔ JSON Converter
description: Convert CSV data to JSON and JSON arrays to CSV.
tagline: Move data between CSV and JSON

steps: Paste CSV data with a header row, or paste a JSON array of objects.
Choose CSV to JSON or JSON to CSV.
Review the converted data and copy or download the result.
features: Supports CSV-to-JSON and JSON-to-CSV conversion.
Uses the first CSV row as column headers.
Handles quoted CSV cells and JSON values in the converter.

faqs.question: What format should my CSV use?
faqs.answer: Use the first row for column names, followed by rows with matching columns.

faqs.question: Can I convert a JSON object?
faqs.answer: The JSON-to-CSV option expects an array of objects, not a single object.

faqs.question: Are nested JSON values supported?
faqs.answer: Nested values are represented as JSON text in the corresponding CSV cell.

title: UUID Generator
description: Generate random version 4 UUIDs in your browser.

steps: Enter the number of UUIDs to generate, from 1 to 100.
Choose Generate UUIDs.
Copy or download the generated identifiers.
features: Generates version 4 UUIDs.
Allows multiple identifiers in one generation.
Uses browser cryptographic randomness when available.

faqs.question: What is a UUID?
faqs.answer: A UUID is a 128-bit identifier commonly used to label records and resources.

faqs.question: Are generated UUIDs sequential?
faqs.answer: No. Version 4 UUIDs are generated using random data rather than a sequential counter.

faqs.question: Can I generate more than one UUID?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose a quantity from 1 to 100.

title: SHA-256 Hash Generator
description: Create a SHA-256 hash from text in your browser.

steps: Enter the text you want to hash.
Choose Generate SHA-256.
Review and copy the 64-character hexadecimal digest.
features: Uses the browser Web Crypto API.
Produces a 256-bit digest shown as hexadecimal text.
The same input produces the same digest.

faqs.question: Can a SHA-256 hash be reversed?
faqs.answer: SHA-256 is designed as a one-way hash function; it is not a reversible encoding.

faqs.question: Will the same text always produce the same hash?
faqs.answer: Yes. The same exact input produces the same SHA-256 digest.

faqs.question: Why is the tool unavailable in some browsers?
faqs.answer: The Web Crypto API requires a supported browser and a secure context such as HTTPS.

title: Password Generator
description: Create a random password with character options.
tagline: Build a password to your needs

steps: Choose a password length between 8 and 128 characters.
Select the character groups to include.
Choose Generate and copy or download the result securely to your own device.
features: Supports uppercase, lowercase, numbers and symbols.
Lets you choose a password length from 8 to 128 characters.
Uses the browser cryptographic random number generator.

faqs.question: Is the generated password stored by ToolNest?
faqs.answer: No. Password generation happens in your browser and ToolNest does not store the generated result.

faqs.question: Can I choose which characters are included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Select the character groups you want before generating a password.

faqs.question: What if I uncheck every character option?
faqs.answer: The tool asks you to select at least one character group before generating a password.

title: Image to Base64
description: Convert a local image into a Base64 data URL.

steps: Choose an image file from your device.
Wait for the image to be read and converted.
Copy or download the resulting data URL as needed.
features: Converts local image files to Base64 data URLs.
Shows an image preview after conversion.
Accepts image files up to 10 MB.

faqs.question: What is an image data URL?
faqs.answer: A data URL contains the image media type and its Base64-encoded data in one text string.

faqs.question: Which image files can I select?
faqs.answer: Choose a file recognized by your browser as an image. Files larger than 10 MB are rejected.

faqs.question: Is my image uploaded?
faqs.answer: The selected file is read locally by your browser; it is not uploaded to a ToolNest server.

title: Forex Currency Converter
description: Convert major currencies using automatically retrieved reference exchange rates.

steps: Enter the amount you want to convert.
Choose the source and target currencies.
Select Convert currency and review the converted amount and rate update time.
features: Supports many currency pairs provided by the rate service.
Shows the reference exchange rate and its update timestamp.
Fetches rates when you request a conversion.

faqs.question: Are exchange rates real-time market prices?
faqs.answer: No. The tool displays reference rates supplied by its external rate provider; they may differ from live trading or payment rates.

faqs.question: Why can a conversion fail?
faqs.answer: The rate service may be unavailable, the currency pair may not be supported, or your connection may be offline.

faqs.question: Are fees included?
faqs.answer: No. Bank, card, transfer and exchange-provider fees are not included.

title: Word & Character Counter
description: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs.

steps: Paste or type text into the input area.
Choose Count text to calculate the statistics.
Review the counts and copy the summary if needed.
features: Counts words and characters.
Also reports sentence and paragraph counts where available.
Processes text locally in your browser.

faqs.question: Are spaces included in the character count?
faqs.answer: The character count follows the tool's displayed counting logic; spaces and line breaks are included in the text length.

faqs.question: How are words counted?
faqs.answer: Words are identified by separating the text at whitespace boundaries.

faqs.question: Can I count a long document?
faqs.answer: You can paste text into the input. Very large documents may be limited by your browser and device memory.

title: Duplicate Lines Remover
description: Remove repeated lines while preserving the first occurrence and original order.

steps: Paste text containing repeated lines into the input area.
Choose Remove duplicate lines.
Review the cleaned text and copy or download the result.
features: Keeps the first occurrence of each repeated line.
Preserves the original order of remaining lines.
Runs in your browser without uploading the text.

faqs.question: Does it keep the original line order?
faqs.answer: Yes. The first occurrence of each exact line stays in its original position.

faqs.question: Are blank lines removed?
faqs.answer: No. Blank lines are left unchanged by the current tool.

faqs.question: Does it treat uppercase and lowercase as duplicates?
faqs.answer: No. The current version compares lines exactly, including letter case and spacing.
